flow: Review is per view. The UI shows the view's review_focus as the QA checklist (shape, scale, material, directional, functional, reference_fidelity). fix_requests carry view_id and edit_eligible. ASX01 and any rejected new_hypotheses route to prop_generator fix mode; the affected views then regenerate.

items.label: Shape differs from the Hero
items.label_fa: فرم با طرح اصلی فرق دارد
items.instruction: Copy silhouette, proportions and the connection of parts exactly from the approved Hero; only the camera angle changes.

items.label: Size looks wrong
items.instruction: Keep true relative size to the scale reference as defined in dna.scale; do not enlarge or shrink the object.

items.label: Colors, materials or wear differ
items.label_fa: رنگ، متریال یا فرسودگی فرق دارد
items.instruction: Match colors, materials, finish and wear to the approved Hero exactly, part by part.

items.label: A detail is mirrored or on the wrong side
items.label_fa: یک جزئیات آینه‌ای یا در سمت اشتباه است
items.instruction: Place every asymmetric detail where the orientation system puts it for this view (viewer's left or right as stated); never mirror the object.

items.label: Text is mirrored or garbled
items.instruction: Render allowed text exactly as quoted, reading left-to-right, not mirrored; other writing as clean non-legible marks.

items.label: Wrong angle (not a true front/side/back)
items.instruction: Place the camera exactly as this view defines: perpendicular to the face, at its center height, long lens, flat perspective.

items.label: The open/closed state or mechanism makes no sense
items.label_fa: وضعیت باز/بسته یا سازوکار منطقی نیست
items.instruction: Move only the moving part, following the hinge side, axis, direction and range in dna.mechanics, in a physically possible way; keep everything else identical.

items.label: A must-keep element was lost
items.instruction: Restore every must_keep item visible from this view, exactly as in the Hero and the DNA.

items.label: Background or light is not neutral
items.instruction: Use the seamless neutral mid-grey background and soft even neutral studio light, same as the Hero.

items.label: Exaggerated perspective
items.instruction: Use a long lens with flat perspective and no wide-angle distortion.

items.label: Detail is blurry or just a crop
items.label_fa: دیتیل تار است یا فقط کراپ شده
items.instruction: Make it a true sharp macro close-up of the detail, with the same material and wear as the Hero.

items.label: The hand or figure looks wrong
items.instruction: Use plain smooth neutral-grey mannequin hands or figure with correctly formed fingers, no skin, nails, sleeves or identity, sized as the scale rule says.

items.label: Labels, numbers or arrows appear
items.label_fa: لیبل، عدد یا فلش اضافه شده
items.instruction: Remove all labels, captions, numbers, arrows, measurements and borders.

items.label: The style differs from the Hero
items.label_fa: سبک با طرح اصلی فرق دارد
items.instruction: Render exactly in the approved Hero's style: form language, material rendering, shading and line work.

items.label: Show a different detail
items.instruction: Replace this detail view with the detail named in the note, chosen from things that exist in the DNA.

items.label: Add a view
items.instruction: Add the view named in the note from the VIEW_LIBRARY, within the level's maximum.

items.label: Something else (write it)
items.instruction: Apply the user's note without changing the design.

items.label: This needs a design change (shape, material, detail, or the proposed hidden part)
items.label_fa: این نیاز به تغییر طراحی دارد (فرم، متریال، جزئیات یا بخش پنهان پیشنهادی)
